description: This file defines a class Upgrade12 which extends a base Controller class for performing database upgrades related to order fields in an OpenCart installation. It reads and updates serialized fields in the order table, migrates data formats, and removes deprecated columns.

classes.name: Upgrade12
classes.description: A controller class responsible for performing database schema and data updates during an upgrade process to version 12.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that executes the upgrade logic, updating serialized fields, migrating data, and cleaning up columns.
